title: Mild chicken tandoori
notes: Mild version: omit chilli and onion. Use lactose-free yoghurt if needed.
ingredients: 600 g chicken thighs or breast, cut into 4–5 cm pieces
method: Cut shallow slits into the thickest parts of the chicken.
Mix yoghurt, oil, spices, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Coat the chicken, cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Place on a lined tray and bake at 220°C conventional or 200°C fan for 25–35 minutes, turning once.
Check the thickest piece reaches 75°C. Rest for 5 minutes and serve with rice and sliced cucumber.
